description: News feed. Retrieve latest financial news with optional keyword and field-specific filtering → Returns {last_update: number, total_items: number, current_items: number, page: number, has_next: boolean, data: [{title?: string, content?: string, link?: string, published_at: number, related_symbols?: string[]}]}.

archive.description: (Optional) Set to true to search older archived news when using filters. Archived results may omit very recent items.

content.description: (Optional) Return only news items whose content contains these values. Matching is case-insensitive and partial; values may be separated by spaces or commas; provide up to 10 values, each with at least 2 characters and at most 50 characters.

filter.description: (Optional) JSONata expression to return only the fields or rows you need. See https://jsonata.org for syntax.

from.description: (Optional) UTC start date. Must be a valid calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format. When provided without to, to is treated as the current UTC date.

keywords.description: (Optional) Keywords to include items that match one of the keywords in the title, content, or related symbols. Values may be separated by spaces or commas; provide up to 10 values, each with at least 2 characters and at most 50 characters. e.g. apple,tesla

limit.description: (Optional) Limit the number of news items returned. Must be an integer between 1 and 500. Default is 500.

output_dir.description: Directory for stored response when output_file is not set.

related_symbols.description: (Optional) Return news items that contain any matching related symbol. Values may be separated by spaces or commas; provide up to 10 values, each with at least 2 characters and at most 50 characters. Exchange-qualified values such as NASDAQ:AAPL require the full symbol; symbol-only values such as AAPL match related symbols after ignoring the exchange prefix.

source.description: (Optional) Return only news items whose source exactly matches this value. Matching is case-insensitive. The value must contain at least 2 characters and at most 50 characters.

store.description: Store the response locally instead of returning it. Default is none. csv is only supported for get_symbol_series.

title.description: (Optional) Return only news items whose title contains these values. Matching is case-insensitive and partial; values may be separated by spaces or commas; provide up to 10 values, each with at least 2 characters and at most 50 characters.

to.description: (Optional) UTC end date. Must be a valid calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Validated but not used when from is absent. Future dates are treated as the current UTC date.

name: get_newsfeed
